learning_outcomes.text: Providing the necessary infrastructure to carry out an effective public relations practice

syllabus_topics: DEFINITION, IMPORTANCE, DEVELOPMENT OF PUBLIC RELATIONS: Definition, Importance, Historical development of public relations, Social responsibility understanding in Public Relations.
DEFINITION, IMPORTANCE, DEVELOPMENT OF PUBLIC RELATIONS: Definition, Importance, Historical development of public relations, Social responsibility understanding in Public Relations.
GOALS, BASIC PRINCIPLES AND ETHICAL APPROACH IN PUBLIC RELATIONS: Aims, Basic principles, Ethics and public relations.
ORGANIZATION OF PUBLIC RELATIONS: The place of the Public Relations Unit in the organization, Organizational structure, Workplace characteristics, Employees' characteristics.
TARGET AUDIENCE IN PUBLIC RELATIONS POLICY: Internal target audience, Non-business target audience.
TARGET GROUP IN PUBLIC RELATIONS POLICY: Non-business target audience, Press relations.
COMMUNICATION TOOLS USED IN PUBLIC RELATIONS: Written tools, Oral tools.
COMMUNICATION TOOLS USED IN PUBLIC RELATIONS: Visual tools, Auditory tools.
EFFECTIVE PRESENTATION TECHNIQUES IN PUBLIC RELATIONS: Planning the presentation, Using audio-visual materials, Effective speaking, Active listening, Questioning technique.
PUBLIC RELATIONS PRACTICE IN TURKEY: public relations in the service business, the public relations industry in business, public relations in the public sector.
